Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human Aromatase (CHEMBL1978). Require canonical SMILES and a PubMed ID or DOI. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, then docs via assays.doc_id. Inner join compound_structures to enforce SMILES presence. Coalesce docs.doi and docs.pubmed_id into pubmed_id_or_doi preferring DOI. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate.
